_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: the user explicitly wants a storyboard or shot sheet as the deliverable. Should-not-trigger: any brief whose deliverable is a finished video — those go to generating-videos or generating-ugc-videos, which call this skill as a step.

cases.query: make me a storyboard for this ad concept
i want storyboard panels showing the four beats
build a shot sheet before we animate anything
make me an unboxing video for our subscription box
video of someone putting on our hoodie, 30 seconds
make a 40 second video about our coffee subscription
animate this photo with a slow push-in
generate an image of a red bicycle in a city street
